# SEO-052: Strip tracking and session parameters from canonical values

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |

| Evidence tier | `A` |
| Confidence | `HIGH` |

## Statement

A canonical href contains no campaign, referral, session, or affiliate parameter, even when the request that produced the page carried one.

## Rationale

Echoing the inbound query string into the canonical turns every shared link into its own canonical address, which defeats the consolidation the declaration exists to perform.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Build the canonical from the route's own path and its content-defining parameters only, using an allowlist of parameters that change what the page shows. Never construct the value by copying the incoming request URL.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Request a page with campaign and session parameters appended, then confirm the emitted canonical omits them.
- Evidence: `RENDERED_HTML`, `ROUTE`
- Automated check: `canonical-no-tracking-params`

## Scope

- Search surfaces: `GOOGLE_SEARCH`, `BING_SEARCH`
- Frameworks: `any`
- Caution: none recorded.
